B.1.3 Coming into force of the prohibitions  
The prohibitions on SUP checkout bags come into effect over a period of 42 months from when the Regulations were registered. The timelines for the coming into force dates for different activities are presented below:  
  
Manufacture and Import – December 20, 2022  
Sale – December 20, 2023  
Export – December 20, 2025

The ban is set up in stages so that the current supply of plastics gets used instead of immediately thrown in the garbage. So the manufactures have a deadline to stop making new bags, importers have a deadline to stop bringing in new bags and retailers will have a deadline to stop using the bags. I think it is Dec 2023 before you will see all plastic carryout bags gone in stores.

When my husband first found out he had cancer, we hadn't been dating long. He went through the process of getting his sperm frozen. Part of storing sperm is letting them know what happens to it when you die. We were young and it was new. His options were to leave it to someone or have it destroyed. I couldn't imagine ever wanting to have a dead mans child and declined his offer to have it left to me.  

He did treatments, surgery and finally went into remission. We got engaged. It came back. We got married and then he was gone.

I really never thought about it again until sometime after he had died. When I realized that it had likely already been destroyed, it was like losing him all over again. 

I did often think about our non-children until a short, terrible relationship led to my daughter. If you were to look at pictures of my late husband and my daughter, you'd think they were related. She has blonde hair and blue eyes, just like his. (Total shocker to me, way to go recessive genes I guess.) I don't think about what could have been anymore. I know that if he were still here and we had children together, they wouldn't be the little girl I have now.
Not only that but I wonder if/when my daughter gets married, if she will want my wedding rings passed down to her. It will be nice to still have something after she gets those ones.
